# from attested sources only:
#   - WMO-No. series numbers 8, 49 and 1364: the issue's series examples.

#     PDF of June 2014); S-412: the issue.
#   - urn:mrn:wmo:pub:...: the issue's proposed IALA-pattern form (no
#     authoritative WMO urn:mrn:wmo: rule is published; the S-411
#     repository carries none).
#   - A-set rows (the widening attestation): WMO-No. 306 — library
#     record 35713 (Manual on Codes); WMO-No. 49, 2019 edition —
#     library record 35722; WMO-No. 574 and its 2024 edition — library
#     viewer 31442; WMO-No. 386, 2020 edition — wmo.int news;
#     WMO-No. 1364, 2023 edition — library record 69478; WMO-No. 1160,
#     2023 edition — library viewer 55063; S-412 1.2.0 — the
#     iho-ohi/S-412-Product-Specification repository and the
#     community.wmo.int S-41X page. These parse on the #763 grammar
#     unchanged; the rows widen the corpus, not the grammar.
#   - Volume rows: WMO-No. 8, Volume I .. Volume V — the community.wmo.int
#     IMOP Guide page; WMO-No. 49, Volume III — library record 35631;
#     WMO-No. 9, Volume D — Resolution 10 (SERCOM-1); WMO-No. 306,
#     Volume I.1 — library record 35713 (dotted-roman sub-volumes).
#   - "WMO-No. 306, Volume I.1, 2020 edition" — the face-order row: both
#     faces individually attested (record 35713; wmo.int news), combined
#     per the widening ruling's order (volume before edition).
#   - Compound-edition rows: "2021/2018 edition" — the IMOP page
#     wording (primary year first); "2023 edition, updated in 2025" —
#     library record 69478; "Provisional 2026 edition" — the IMOP
#     Knowledge-Hub.
#   - WMO/TD-No. rows: 196 — the library serial "TECHNICAL DOCUMENT /
#     WMO/TD-No. 196" and the typhooncommittee.org TCP-23 PDF;
#     1086/1215/1466 — the JCOMM cross-references (TR 14 = TD 1086,
#     record 37163; TR 24 = TD 1215; TR 47 = TD 1466, record 55084).
#   - JCOMM Technical Report No. rows: 14 — record 37163; 24 — the
#     library serial search; 47 — record 55084.
#   - GAW Report No. rows (bare head, WMO's own records): 312 — library
#     record 69472 (file GAW-Report-No312_en); 285 — file GAW-285_en.
#   - The MRN rows over the new shapes follow the same proposed form.
